two-sum: class Solution { public: vector<int> twoSum(vector<int>& nums, int target) { unordered_map<int,int> seen; for(int i=0;i<(int)nums.size();++i) { if(seen.count(target-nums[i])) return {seen[target-nums[i]],i}; seen[nums[i]]=i; } return {}; } };
valid-parentheses: class Solution { public: bool isValid(string s) { stack<char> st; for(char c:s) { if(c=='('||c=='['||c=='{') st.push(c); else { if(st.empty()) return false; char t=st.top(); st.pop(); if((c==')'&&t!='(')||(c==']'&&t!='[')||(c=='}'&&t!='{')) return false; } } return st.empty(); } };
best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock: class Solution { public: int maxProfit(vector<int>& prices) { int low=INT_MAX, ans=0; for(int p:prices) { low=min(low,p); ans=max(ans,p-low); } return ans; } };
contains-duplicate: class Solution { public: bool containsDuplicate(vector<int>& nums) { unordered_set<int> s; for(int n:nums) if(!s.insert(n).second) return true; return false; } };
binary-search: class Solution { public: int search(vector<int>& nums, int target) { int l=0,r=(int)nums.size()-1; while(l<=r) { int m=l+(r-l)/2; if(nums[m]==target) return m; if(nums[m]<target) l=m+1; else r=m-1; } return -1; } };
maximum-subarray: class Solution { public: int maxSubArray(vector<int>& nums) { int best=nums[0], cur=nums[0]; for(int i=1;i<(int)nums.size();++i) { cur=max(nums[i],cur+nums[i]); best=max(best,cur); } return best; } };
longest-substring-without-repeating-char: class Solution { public: int lengthOfLongestSubstring(string s) { vector<int> last(256,-1); int left=0,best=0; for(int i=0;i<(int)s.size();++i) { unsigned char c=s[i]; left=max(left,last[c]+1); best=max(best,i-left+1); last[c]=i; } return best; } };
3sum: class Solution { public: vector<vector<int>> threeSum(vector<int>& nums) { sort(nums.begin(),nums.end()); vector<vector<int>> ans; int n=nums.size(); for(int i=0;i<n;++i) { if(i&&nums[i]==nums[i-1]) continue; int l=i+1,r=n-1; while(l<r) { long long sum=(long long)nums[i]+nums[l]+nums[r]; if(sum<0) ++l; else if(sum>0) --r; else { ans.push_back({nums[i],nums[l],nums[r]}); int a=nums[l],b=nums[r]; while(l<r&&nums[l]==a) ++l; while(l<r&&nums[r]==b) --r; } } } return ans; } };
search-in-rotated-sorted-array: class Solution { public: int search(vector<int>& nums,int target) { int l=0,r=(int)nums.size()-1; while(l<=r) { int m=l+(r-l)/2; if(nums[m]==target) return m; if(nums[l]<=nums[m]) { if(nums[l]<=target&&target<nums[m]) r=m-1; else l=m+1; } else { if(nums[m]<target&&target<=nums[r]) l=m+1; else r=m-1; } } return -1; } };
number-of-islands: class Solution { public: int numIslands(vector<vector<char>>& grid) { int rows=grid.size(); if(!rows) return 0; int cols=grid[0].size(),ans=0; int dr[4]={1,-1,0,0},dc[4]={0,0,1,-1}; for(int i=0;i<rows;++i) for(int j=0;j<cols;++j) { if(grid[i][j]!='1') continue; ++ans; queue<pair<int,int>> q; q.push({i,j}); grid[i][j]='0'; while(!q.empty()) { auto [r,c]=q.front(); q.pop(); for(int k=0;k<4;++k) { int nr=r+dr[k],nc=c+dc[k]; if(nr>=0&&nr<rows&&nc>=0&&nc<cols&&grid[nr][nc]=='1') { grid[nr][nc]='0'; q.push({nr,nc}); } } } } return ans; } };
trapping-rain-water: class Solution { public: int trap(vector<int>& height) { int l=0,r=(int)height.size()-1, lm=0,rm=0,ans=0; while(l<r) { if(height[l]<=height[r]) { lm=max(lm,height[l]); ans+=lm-height[l]; ++l; } else { rm=max(rm,height[r]); ans+=rm-height[r]; --r; } } return ans; } };
minimum-window-substring: class Solution { public: string minWindow(string s,string t) { if(t.empty()) return ""; vector<int> need(256,0); for(unsigned char c:t) ++need[c]; int remaining=t.size(),l=0,best=INT_MAX,start=0; for(int r=0;r<(int)s.size();++r) { unsigned char c=s[r]; if(need[c]-->0) --remaining; while(remaining==0) { if(r-l+1<best) { best=r-l+1; start=l; } unsigned char x=s[l++]; if(++need[x]>0) ++remaining; } } return best==INT_MAX?"":s.substr(start,best); } };
merge-k-sorted-lists: class Solution { public: ListNode* mergeKLists(vector<ListNode*>& lists) { auto cmp=[](ListNode* a,ListNode* b){return a->val>b->val;}; priority_queue<ListNode*,vector<ListNode*>,decltype(cmp)> pq(cmp); for(auto p:lists) if(p) pq.push(p); ListNode dummy(0),*tail=&dummy; while(!pq.empty()) { auto p=pq.top(); pq.pop(); tail->next=p; tail=p; if(p->next) pq.push(p->next); } tail->next=nullptr; return dummy.next; } };
binary-tree-maximum-path-sum: class Solution { int best=INT_MIN; int gain(TreeNode* root) { if(!root) return 0; int l=max(0,gain(root->left)),r=max(0,gain(root->right)); best=max(best,root->val+l+r); return root->val+max(l,r); } public: int maxPathSum(TreeNode* root) { best=INT_MIN; gain(root); return best; } };
sliding-window-maximum: class Solution { public: vector<int> maxSlidingWindow(vector<int>& nums,int k) { deque<int> dq; vector<int> ans; for(int i=0;i<(int)nums.size();++i) { while(!dq.empty()&&dq.front()<=i-k) dq.pop_front(); while(!dq.empty()&&nums[dq.back()]<=nums[i]) dq.pop_back(); dq.push_back(i); if(i>=k-1) ans.push_back(nums[dq.front()]); } return ans; } };
